title: rudbeckia angustifolia
intro: Rudbeckia angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved coneflower or black-eyed Susan, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rudbeckia angustifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
